title: Working with files - Gravit Designer Help
text: Gravit Designer includes support for a wide range of file formats. You can open and edit raster images such as JPEG, PNG, and HEIC.
Gravit Designer also supports a range of  vector file formats. You can open and edit PDF, EPS, SVG and compressed SVG.
In addition, Gravit Designer has a proprietary vector file format, gvdesign, which is recommended for full fidelity and best performance.
For more information about supported vector and bitmap file types, see this article.
In this chapter, you’ll learn the basics to get started:
How to launch a document. How to set a document size and units
How to use Gravit Designer templates to streamline your design workflow
How to save and open the files
How to work with Gravit Designer Cloud
